retrievalProfile.description: A sepia-toned hand-drawn sketch featuring a dual-perspective portrait on aged parchment with classical serif typography.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist sans-serif layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic sepia composition showing two overlapping views of the same bearded man—one facing forward and one in profile—rendered in a soft, charcoal-like sketching style on a textured, stained paper background.
coreVisualRelationships: overlapping facial features creating a composite identity
centered subject matter against a wide textured field
top-aligned primary text balanced by bottom-aligned secondary text
tonal harmony between the sketch medium and the paper substrate
coreInvariants: soft-edged charcoal or graphite line work

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The dual portrait is centrally located, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The forward-facing eyes of the left portrait serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top text down to the eyes of the portrait, then follows the profile line to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left and right edges, filled with parchment texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia brown for the sketch and text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light tan/beige for the parchment background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Darker burnt umber for deep shadows in the beard and eyes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a narrow value range, emphasizing texture over high contrast.

letterConstructionRules: overlapping characters in the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' and 'H' in the top line are tightly kerned to touch
The 'S' characters have deep, elegant curves
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and tracking.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic proportions and sharp serifs match the era's aesthetic.
High contrast between thick and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned charcoal sketch of a man's face in a double exposure style (one front view, one profile) on a heavily textured, stained parchment paper background. Ensure the drawing has soft, blended edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply classical serif typography in a dark sepia color. The top text should be large, uppercase, and tightly kerned. The bottom text should be smaller, uppercase, and widely tracked.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Do the two faces overlap naturally?
Is the paper texture visible through the sketch?
Is the top text centered and larger than the bottom text?

adjustableVariables: tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: any use of modern digital brushes that look too clean
postGenerationChecks: Check for charcoal smudge details in the beard.
Verify the parchment has non-uniform staining.
Ensure the serif terminals are sharp and distinct.
Confirm the double exposure effect maintains facial recognition.
